description: quote do defstruct [:a, :b] end is parse/expected-token: 'unsupported expression prefix in compiler2 front door: Defstruct'. The front door reads defstruct only as an item (parse_struct_item, src/compiler2/frontdoor.rs). A hand-built {:defstruct, %{}, [fields]} returned by an item macro already defines the struct. defstruct inside quote reads as that call node, with the field list an ordinary quoted expression so unquote works in it ([__exception__: true] ++ unquote(fields)).
